knowledge.text: PKCE將授權碼兌換綁到verifier；若verifier由均勻隨機位元組產生，原始熵上限為8n位元，但不等於整個系統安全強度。

steps.instruction:

在交接件中加入「OAuth 2.0 安全實務：資產、信任邊界與測試資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：用紙面序列圖串接授權碼、S256 PKCE challenge、verifier與token端點；在圖上標出state、精確redirect URI與refresh token輪替的不同功能。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：用紙面序列圖串接授權碼、S256 PKCE challenge、verifier與token端點；在圖上標出state、精確redirect URI與refresh token輪替的不同功能。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver a protocol sequence, fingerprints of verifier test vectors and token-consumption states.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for OAuth 2.0 security：Assets, trust boundaries and test fixtures: Draw the authorization code, S256 PKCE challenge, verifier and token endpoint; distinguish state, exact redirect URI and refresh-token rotation. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Draw the authorization code, S256 PKCE challenge, verifier and token endpoint; distinguish state, exact redirect URI and refresh-token rotation. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。用紙面序列圖串接授權碼、S256 PKCE challenge、verifier與token端點；在圖上標出state、精確redirect URI與refresh token輪替的不同功能。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Draw the authorization code, S256 PKCE challenge, verifier and token endpoint; distinguish state, exact redirect URI and refresh-token rotation. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 用紙面序列圖串接授權碼、S256 PKCE challenge、verifier與token端點；在圖上標出state、精確redirect URI與refresh token輪替的不同功能。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.checkEn: Draw the authorization code, S256 PKCE challenge, verifier and token endpoint; distinguish state, exact redirect URI and refresh-token rotation. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: RFC 9700 彙整 OAuth 安全實務，涵蓋授權流程、重新導向與權杖重播風險。
knowledge.textEn: RFC 9700 collects OAuth security practices covering authorization flows, redirects and token replay risks.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 用紙面序列圖串接授權碼、S256 PKCE challenge、verifier與token端點；在圖上標出state、精確redirect URI與refresh token輪替的不同功能。
knowledge.textEn: Draw the authorization code, S256 PKCE challenge, verifier and token endpoint; distinguish state, exact redirect URI and refresh-token rotation.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: PKCE將授權碼兌換綁到verifier；若verifier由均勻隨機位元組產生，原始熵上限為8n位元，但不等於整個系統安全強度。
knowledge.textEn: PKCE binds code redemption to a verifier; n uniformly random bytes provide at most 8n bits of source entropy, not the strength of the entire system.
